scene.label: Act 3, Scene 6
scene.title: SCENE VI. Wales. Before the cave of Belarius.
scene.location: Wales. Before the cave of Belarius.

content.text: Enter Imogen alone, in boy's clothes.

lines.text: I see a man's life is a tedious one.
lines.plainText: I see a man's life is a tedious one

lines.text: I have tir'd myself, and for two nights together
lines.plainText: I have tir'd myself and for two nights together

lines.text: Have made the ground my bed. I should be sick
lines.plainText: Have made the ground my bed I should be sick

lines.text: But that my resolution helps me. Milford,
lines.plainText: But that my resolution helps me Milford

lines.text: When from the mountain-top Pisanio show'd thee,
lines.plainText: When from the mountaintop Pisanio show'd thee

lines.text: Thou wast within a ken. O Jove! I think
lines.plainText: Thou wast within a ken O Jove I think

lines.text: Foundations fly the wretched; such, I mean,
lines.plainText: Foundations fly the wretched such I mean

lines.text: Where they should be reliev'd. Two beggars told me
lines.plainText: Where they should be reliev'd Two beggars told me

lines.text: I could not miss my way. Will poor folks lie,
lines.plainText: I could not miss my way Will poor folks lie

lines.text: That have afflictions on them, knowing 'tis
lines.plainText: That have afflictions on them knowing 'tis

lines.text: A punishment or trial? Yes; no wonder,
lines.plainText: A punishment or trial Yes no wonder

lines.text: When rich ones scarce tell true. To lapse in fulness
lines.plainText: When rich ones scarce tell true To lapse in fulness

lines.text: Is sorer than to lie for need; and falsehood
lines.plainText: Is sorer than to lie for need and falsehood

lines.text: Is worse in kings than beggars. My dear lord!
lines.plainText: Is worse in kings than beggars My dear lord

lines.text: Thou art one o' th' false ones. Now I think on thee
lines.plainText: Thou art one o' th' false ones Now I think on thee

lines.text: My hunger's gone; but even before, I was
lines.plainText: My hunger's gone but even before I was

lines.text: At point to sink for food. But what is this?
lines.plainText: At point to sink for food But what is this

lines.text: Here is a path to't; 'tis some savage hold.
lines.plainText: Here is a path to't 'tis some savage hold

lines.text: I were best not call; I dare not call. Yet famine,
lines.plainText: I were best not call I dare not call Yet famine

lines.text: Ere clean it o'erthrow nature, makes it valiant.
lines.plainText: Ere clean it o'erthrow nature makes it valiant

lines.text: Plenty and peace breeds cowards; hardness ever
lines.plainText: Plenty and peace breeds cowards hardness ever

lines.text: Of hardiness is mother. Ho! who's here?
lines.plainText: Of hardiness is mother Ho who's here

lines.text: If anything that's civil, speak; if savage,
lines.plainText: If anything that's civil speak if savage

lines.text: Take or lend. Ho! No answer? Then I'll enter.
lines.plainText: Take or lend Ho No answer Then I'll enter

lines.text: Best draw my sword; and if mine enemy
lines.plainText: Best draw my sword and if mine enemy

lines.text: But fear the sword, like me, he'll scarcely look on't.
lines.plainText: But fear the sword like me he'll scarcely look on't

lines.text: Such a foe, good heavens!
lines.plainText: Such a foe good heavens
